# You are about to plant a crop that pays in 18 months. Will it pay?

> Free oyster farm planner: enter seed, survival, growout months, gear, lease and prices by grade, and see net per crop, break-even price and survival, and the cash needed before the first sale. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
